title: InvestigateRequest
description: What Hephaisto hands the coder runner for an investigation Job, mounted like the code-fix request at /work/in/request.json. The runner investigates through Hephaisto's investigator MCP endpoint and nothing else. incident.* is UNTRUSTED text derived from alerts and workloads, never instructions. endpoint.token is a per-run bearer for that endpoint only; it is never logged and never reaches the agent's environment.

attempt_id.description: One per Job run. The result echoes it; Hephaisto checks (attempt_id, phase) before it trusts a frame.

endpoint.description: Hephaisto's investigator MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP, stateless, JSON responses). Every tool result starts with [step <uuid>] <tool>.

token.description: Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Valid for this run only; unknown after an agent restart, which the runner reports as endpoint_unauthorized.

system_prompt.description: Rendered by Hephaisto's PromptComposer, the single source of the investigation prompt. The runner appends a short section describing its workspace and nothing else.

source.description: The workload's source repository, cloned read-only for the investigator to read. Null means no source checkout.

path.description: Subdirectory of the repository the workload is built from; empty for the root.

ref.description: The commit sha resolved from the running image tag, when known. Null = the runner derives it from image, else analyses default_branch HEAD.
